name: Message
description: Represents a secure, encrypted message exchanged between a patient and a doctor.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owning patient — set automatically from the associated patient; only the owning patient or an admin/doctor may access.

attributes.name: senderPatientId
attributes.description: Foreign key to PatientProfile if sender is a patient.

attributes.name: senderDoctorId
attributes.description: Foreign key to DoctorProfile if sender is a doctor.

attributes.name: receiverPatientId
attributes.description: Foreign key to PatientProfile if receiver is a patient.

attributes.name: receiverDoctorId
attributes.description: Foreign key to DoctorProfile if receiver is a doctor.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

attributes.name: isRead
attributes.description: True if the message has been read by the recipient.

attributes.name: appointmentId
attributes.description: Optional foreign key to an associated Appointment.
